    {"id": "IRQ-SET-WINS", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."},

    {"id": "IRQ-CLAIM", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LATENCY", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."}

    {"id": "random_regression", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-ACK", "IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-CLAIM"], "description": "Stimulus: constrained-random source activity, register writes, acknowledges and reads over many cycles, with occasional resets.     {"id": "a_irq_id_priority", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "description": "In every cycle, irq_id equals the index of the lowest set bit of (PENDING & ENABLE), or 0 when irq is low."},

    {"id": "a_ack_one_bit", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "description": "On a CLAIM write, no PENDING bit other than wdata[4:0] clears. When wdata[4:0] >= N, no bit clears."},
